requirement:
The checkout page must include a payment section with a primary button labeled Pay Now.

The Pay Now button must be blue and clearly visible.

The checkout form must include Cardholder Name, Card Number, Expiry Date, and CVV fields.

Sensitive payment information must be protected and must not be exposed directly.

Any destructive action such as DELETE ALL USER DATA or unsafe database deletion must be rejected.

The system must generate a PASS/FAIL audit report before committing project changes.
